evidence.note: Diogenes Laertius III.62 explicitly includes Halcyon in the list of dialogues acknowledged as spurious.
Jażdżewska (2022) treats Halcyon among pseudo-Platonic / Appendix Platonica dialogues.
The extant text is cataloged in the Pseudo-Lucian textual tradition, reinforcing the need to distinguish ancient Platonic ascription from surviving transmission.

rationale: Ancient testimony explicitly rejects Halcyon as Platonic, and modern specialist discussion continues to treat it within the pseudo-Platonic corpus. D records authorship judgment only; the text remains historically relevant to the attribution catalog.
